description: Zenodo publishes a gap-filled daily precipitation series for 201 stations across Central Italy from 1951 to 2019. The record lists a station-location CSV and MAT arrays of observed, estimated and final values, plus a nearby-station information file. It states CC BY 4.0 and public access without a fee. The authors combined quantile mapping, spatial interpolation, machine learning and ERA5 information to fill missing values and checked the results with several error measures. The series can calibrate rainfall-runoff, urban drainage and flood simulations over its station network. Gap-filled values are estimates, not measurements; users should preserve the distinction among the three MAT arrays when validating a model. Station density and elevation may leave local rainfall differences unresolved, especially for short storms. It complements data-era5-reanalysis with a Central Italy station-based daily series. No MAT or CSV file was downloaded.
